verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's GitHub README describes an AI agent that searches, navigates, and retrieves data from a description, and says you can 'Set how much reasoning the agent spends on the task', so the product directly offers a reasoning-effort control. The evidence is a single thin line that does not name the low/medium/high levels or how they are set. missing for 10: documented low/medium/high effort values, API/SDK parameter docs for the setting, explanation of cost or depth trade-offs per level, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
